Subject: dispatch hiring at Calder

Hi Marcus,

Saw Calder Freight is hiring a dispatch coordinator. Dispatch roles usually mean someone copying loads between email, spreadsheets and the TMS.

We built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards.

Worth a look?

Sam
Nextron AI
Quick question before anything else - does this connect to Dynamics GP? That's where all our orders end up.
